subject: Hosted eval: sandbox slice request, traffic envelope & next steps
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Solis <megan@lumenpay.com>, Evan Kim <evan.kim@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick follow-up and a small info ask after today's demo

Hi Megan / Evan,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation and appreciate the candid notes about compliance and throughput expectations. I wanted to capture the immediate next steps so we can move your Hosted evaluation forward without delay.

Recap (high level)
- You are most interested in the Hosted API to start (low ops overhead), but want clear cost/runway visibility and a path to Dedicated or Private if residency/SLA needs change.
- Primary use: real-time underwriting assistant in the payments flow (low-latency single-turn inference + embeddings for similarity).
- Security: PII surface is present in some payload fields; you'll need retention controls and SOC2 evidence.

Quick asks to size the sandbox slice and provide a hosted quickstart: (if you can send these today/tomorrow it will help my team provision)
1) Expected production QPS (peak) and a realistic 24h request count (e.g., 10k req/day with 60 QPS peak).
2) Typical prompt + response token counts (average tokens in / out).
3) Latency SLO target (p50/p95) for inference.
4) Any must-have network constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlist) or data residency requirements.

What we'll deliver next (target within 48 hours of your traffic profile):
- Hosted sandbox endpoints (shared sandbox key, sandbox-credentials.pdf) scoped to a throttled slice and sample cURL.
- Proposed rate plan and burst ceilings (hosted-rateplan.xlsx).
- SOC2 summary and retention defaults (SOC2-summary.pdf) + pointer on custom retention settings.

If Hosted is the right starting point we can enable a constrained sandbox slice (prefix caching off, conservative batching) so you can validate latency and quality under realistic traffic. If anything points to Dedicated/Private we will surface the migration path and delta.

Would you prefer we set up the sandbox as a single endpoint for initial QA, or two endpoints (one for scoring / low-latency and one for batch embeddings)?

Thanks — I’ll hold off on provisioning until I get your traffic/profile answers.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: (will send sandbox creds and rate plan once we get the traffic pulse)

From: Megan Solis <megan@lumenpay.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Kim <evan.kim@lumenpay.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and a small info ask after today's demo

Thanks Rohan — nice recap. A few quick data points from our side:

- Preferred start: Hosted (we want to evaluate before committing infra).
- Approximate traffic: 8,500 requests/day; expected peak around 55-65 QPS for short spikes (checkout flows).
- Tokens: average request ~120 tokens in, ~180 tokens out.
- Latency target: p95 <= 450ms for real-time scoring; p50 target ~120ms.
- Data residency: US only for now; no on-prem requirement yet.

Security/compliance:
- We need SOC2 evidence to share with our InfoSec team.
- Retention: we prefer to keep inference logs for 7 days and then delete; want to confirm Redwood supports configurable retention per customer.
- IP allowlist: yes — we'll need a small set of static IPs for webhook callbacks.

Endpoint preference: single endpoint to start (simpler for integration), but we may ask for a separate embeddings endpoint once we test model quality.

If you can provision a sandbox slice limited to 70 QPS burst and a daily token cap, that will let us run a 48–72h smoke test. Also send the SOC2 summary and the sample cURL we can run from our staging.

Megan
Megan Solis
Head of Integrations | LumenPay
megan@lumenpay.com

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 10:37:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow-up and a small info ask after today's demo — LumenPay wants hosted sandbox slice

Monica / Ben — forwarding Megan's reply (below). They prefer Hosted to start, gave the traffic envelope and latency targets. Can you please carve a sandbox slice and confirm the following by Monday morning:

Action items for provisioning
- Sandbox endpoint (single endpoint for initial work), rate-limited to 70 QPS burst and a daily token cap of ~2M tokens (we can adjust).
- Provide: sandbox-credentials.pdf (API key + expiration), hosted-rateplan.xlsx with explicit qps/burst ceilings, and SOC2-summary.pdf for the security packet.
- Sample cURL and a one-line curl-snippet for our docs that shows header to set retention=7d (if supported).
- Confirm whether prefix/KV caching can be enabled for their flow (they use short prompts but reuse tokens across sessions). If not, provide recommendation and expected latency impact.
- IP allowlist: produce the minimal IP set they should add.

Ben — can you own the sandbox provisioning and SOC2 packet? Monica — want you to sit on the config (rate ceilings + caching). I’ll coordinate with Megan/Evan on kickoff once we have the artifacts.

Thanks,
Rohan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted sandbox slice provisioned + next actions (LumenPay D-4821-LP)

Hi Megan / Evan / Rohan,

Thanks — we provisioned a constrained Hosted sandbox for LumenPay. Summary of what we delivered and how to hit it from staging:

What we provisioned (sandbox)
- Endpoint: https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/lumenpay/score
- API key: see attached sandbox-credentials.pdf (key blinded for security in this message). Expires in 14 days.
- Rate limits: steady-state 30 QPS; burst up to 70 QPS for windows up to 30s. Daily token cap: 2,000,000 tokens. Details in hosted-rateplan.xlsx (attached).
- Retention: logs set to 7 days by default for this sandbox; we included the header x-redwood-retention-days that you can pass to override within allowed range.
- IP allowlist: 3 egress IPs for webhooks: 34.203.12.45, 34.203.12.46, 34.203.12.47.
- Caching: prefix (KV) caching is off for this sandbox to mirror production request patterns; enabling caching could reduce p95 by ~120ms on your traffic shape — we can toggle for the second test run.

Sample cURL (quick smoke):
curl -X POST \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "x-redwood-retention-days: 7" \n  -d '{"input":"Detect fraud risk for transaction: id=1234, amount=129.95, user=..."}' \n  https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/lumenpay/score

Attachments included:
- sandbox-credentials.pdf (API key + expiration + basic integration notes)
- hosted-rateplan.xlsx (detailed ceilings and token accounting)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (control scope + auditor and certificate excerpt)

Next steps
- Megan / Evan: run a 48–72h smoke test and share any production traces that hit p95 > 450ms. If p95 is within target, we will propose turning on conservative KV caching and a second embeddings endpoint.
- Rohan / Monica / Ben: we'll prepare a short migration note describing the delta to move to Dedicated (throughput guarantees, cost delta) should LumenPay want to expand. I’ll attach that to the deal page in the app.

If you want a short handoff call Monday to walk through the creds and sample calls, I can join.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
